statement: NVIDIA H200 street purchase price is quoted at $30,000-$40,000 per unit across resellers, against a list price of $40,000-$55,000
why: A static level with no stated baseline or change; it shows where street pricing sits, not which way it is moving.

impact.mechanism: Street purchase price sets the hardware cost basis for buyers, but with no prior period given it carries no directional signal.

evidence.source: aggregated web search (IntuitionLabs, GPU Battle, JarvisLabs, getdeploying.com)
evidence.excerpt: street/reseller purchase price reported as $30,000-$40,000 per unit

confidence.basis: Aggregated secondary price pages with no explicit as-of date; range varies by source and configuration.

dispersion: Range across sources $31,000-$44,000 depending on configuration; H200 NVL 141GB quoted $31,000-$32,000; list/MSRP $40,000-$55,000.
